features.description: A module outside a feature folder in src/features/ names the feature only by its folder, which resolves to its index.ts; only the composition root in src/app/ imports a feature's modules directly.

layers.name: kit
layers.description: The presentation kit outside src/ depends on no application module.

layers.name: model
layers.description: The pure model depends on no data, navigation, platform, mock or view module.

layers.name: bridge
layers.description: The bridge depends on no view, shell, application or mock module, and reads only the chat host contract, src/chat/local-contract.ts, from src/chat/.

layers.name: data and platform
layers.description: Data, scheduling, diagnostics, navigation, platform and resource modules depend on no view, chat, shell, application or mock module.

layers.name: mock
layers.description: The mock bridge and fixture depend on no feature, view, shell or application module.

layers.name: components
layers.description: Shared components depend on no feature, screen, chat, shell, application or mock module.

layers.name: shell
layers.description: The window chrome depends on no application or mock module.

layers.name: features
layers.description: Feature folders, the remaining screens and chat depend on no application or mock module.

layers.name: app
layers.description: The composition root reaches the mock only through the bridge selection.
